nina: Started a 0.5% canary for v5-int4 on mixed routes. Early perf wins but odd quality drop on very long-reply tasks (>3k tokens).

raul: drop numbers?

nina: coherence -2.1% on long-reply slice (paired test p=0.004), halluc +1.3pp. p95 latency neutral. samples: ctrl=6k, var=1.1k.

kevin: sample small. we should have session-pin for routing and min_samples=2k for slice eval. also add a session-aware fallback so existing sessions keep KV state.

ci-bot: canary event: v5-int4 -> 0.5% (nina)

nina: proposing immediate policy: 1) throttle long-reply ramp to 0.1% and enable fallback action route_new_sessions_to_v5fp16 for that slice; 2) capture 300 failing pairs to s3 for triage; 3) run paired-bootstrap after 30m.

raul: +1. Also record quant kernel rev in metadata (we saw regressions tied to kernel r12 before).

kevin: I'll add slice-level fallback config to gatebook and enforce a 20m evidence window before auto-fallback triggers.

nina: done. reducing long-reply to 0.1% and enabling new-session fallback. will post bootstrap results in ~30m.

ci-bot: alert: long-reply coherence delta exceeded threshold (rolling 20m). failing pairs stored at s3://redwood-experiments/1844440000/failed.tar.gz

raul: keep canary running at constrained split for extra samples but no further ramp until bootstrap confirms.

nina: noted. filing follow-ups: (1) gatebook entry for session-aware fallback (kevin), (2) postmortem sketch and sample diffs (me), (3) kernel-rev telemetry (raul).
